services.name: Jet Ski Rental
services.desc: Fifty - Fifty Water Sports, LLC believes our great customer service combined with experience of the Lake Murray, SC waters provide the jet ski renter a superior rental experience. With everything a jet ski renter could want you can feel free to explore and see what beautiful Lake Murray, SC has to offer. For fun in the sun at your own pace give us a try for all your jet ski rental needs. Cruising Lake Murray on a jet ski is a perfect way to view all the beauty the lake has to offer.
